title: Payment method
description: The customer's payment method, captured at payment time on the Present-payment HITL task and fed to charge_payment as its tender. Human-authored (no agent draft); the enum drives the Present-payment dropdown. On a decline, the Resolve-payment task re-captures this artifact (supersede — the retry tender), so a non-declined value ends the payment-resolution loop. Author this schema in the wizard.

tender.description: The tender charge_payment captures. "declined" simulates a declined card to drive the payment-resolution loop; "card"/"cash" capture cleanly and end it.
